title: Fix NewOrderPage order placement perpetual loading and improve error handling

requirements.summary: Fix root cause of order placement getting stuck on loading by ensuring the create-order mutation always settles (success/error) and never hangs indefinitely.
acceptanceCriteria: From NewOrderPage, submitting a valid order reliably completes within a reasonable time and no longer stays stuck in the loading state.
If the backend rejects/traps (e.g., unauthorized, banned, rate-limited, duplicate ID), the frontend exits loading state and displays an English error message.
If the network/agent call hangs, the frontend times out, exits loading state, and shows an actionable English error message (e.g., "Request timed out. Please try again.").

file_operations.description: Ensure the create-order mutation cannot remain pending indefinitely by wrapping canister calls (ban check + order creation) in a deterministic timeout and propagating a consistent error when the timeout triggers.

Make the submit flow resilient to failures and hangs: clear prior errors on submit, surface mapped English error messages in the existing destructive Alert, and ensure the UI returns to an interactive state after any failure.
Add a small Promise.race-based timeout utility used by order placement to guarantee requests settle (resolve or reject) within a defined window.
Centralize conversion of actor/network errors into clear English messages (e.g., Unauthorized/sign-in prompt, security block/rate limiting, banned, duplicate ID) so UI never shows only a spinner.

requirements.summary: Add a timeout to the create-order canister call so the mutation rejects on hangs and `createOrder.isPending` cannot remain true indefinitely.
acceptanceCriteria: If the backend call does not settle within the defined timeout window, the mutation rejects, `createOrder.isPending` becomes false, and the user sees a timeout error message in English.
After any failure (validation error, banned, unauthorized, rate-limited, timeout), the user can immediately click the submit button again (no stuck pending state).

file_operations.description: Implement a reusable timeout wrapper (Promise.race) that rejects with a timeout error after a configured duration; use it for canister calls involved in order placement.
Wrap the backend order-creation call in the timeout utility so the mutation always settles; ensure timeout rejection flows through react-query so pending state clears and retries are possible.

requirements.summary: Improve NewOrderPage error reporting so backend traps/rejects are converted to clear English messages and shown in the existing Alert, including unauthorized/security-block/duplicate-ID scenarios.
acceptanceCriteria: When the backend returns an Unauthorized error, the page shows an English message prompting the user to sign in.
When the backend indicates a security block (e.g., rate limiting / "TREY C SECURITY"), the page shows an English message explaining the request was blocked and to retry later.

When the backend indicates a duplicate order ID, the page shows an English message and the app auto-retries with a new generated order ID or instructs the user to retry (implementation choice is acceptable as long as it is not stuck).

file_operations.description: Add an error-normalization helper that inspects thrown errors and returns user-facing English messages for Unauthorized, banned, security block/rate limit (including "TREY C SECURITY"-style traps), duplicate ID, network errors, and timeouts.
Use the shared error-normalization helper when rethrowing/creating errors from ban checks, timeouts, and actor failures so calling pages can display consistent English messages.

Update submit error handling to display normalized English messages in the existing destructive Alert; add a safe duplicate-ID handling strategy (auto-retry once with a newly generated orderId, or show a clear retry instruction) while ensuring the submit button is never stuck disabled.
